title: 上海中心大廈~Shanghai Tower
focus: 巨型框架、核心筒與外伸臂三重體系，配合扭轉外形、軟土深基礎與柔性懸掛帷幕的整合設計~A mega-frame, core and outrigger triple system integrated with a twisting form, deep soft-ground foundations and a flexibly hung façade
summary: 從 120° 扭轉外形帶來的 24% 風載折減與上海軟土的長週期地震需求出發，計算 C70 巨柱的軸壓比與雙層外伸桁架的斜桿力，再處理圓形地下連續壁與 6 m 筏基的一次澆置、鋼平台爬模與超高泵送、後注漿長樁驗證、性能設計的層間變位檢核，最後是懸掛式外層帷幕與超高速電梯鋼索在營運期的維護。~Starting from the 24% wind-load reduction of the 120° twisting form and the long-period seismic demand of Shanghai's soft ground, compute the axial-load ratio of C70 mega-columns and diagonal forces in two-storey outriggers, then handle the circular diaphragm wall and single 6 m mat pour, steel-platform climbing forms and extreme pumping, proof of post-grouted long piles and performance-based drift checks, ending with in-service upkeep of the hung outer façade and ropes of ultra-fast elevators.

units.title: 扭轉漸縮外形與 24% 風載折減~Twisting tapered form and a 24% wind-load cut
units.mechanism: 上海中心大廈的外層帷幕以圓角三角形平面隨高度旋轉約 120°，並逐漸縮小，外緣還有一道垂直凹槽。旋轉與漸縮讓不同高度的迎風寬度與分離點不斷改變，渦流無法沿高度同步脫落；設計者公開說明，經風洞試驗優化外形後，結構風載比同高度的矩形建築約少 24%，結構材料因此減輕。風載減少會沿著外伸臂、巨柱與基礎一路傳遞成材料節省。~Shanghai Tower's outer façade is a rounded triangle in plan that rotates about 120° up the height while tapering, with a vertical notch along one edge. Rotation and taper keep changing the windward width and separation points with height, so vortices cannot shed coherently along the tower; the designers report that wind-tunnel refinement of the form cut structural wind loads by about 24% compared with a rectangular building of the same height, lightening the structure. The reduction carries through the outriggers, mega-columns and foundations as material savings.
units.model: 若矩形對照方案基底彎矩 M₀ = 30 GN·m，24% 折減後 M = 30×0.76 = 22.8 GN·m。若外伸臂把 60% 傾覆彎矩交給巨柱、受拉與受壓側巨柱群力臂 50 m，每側巨柱群的軸力變化由 0.6×30,000/50 = 360 MN 降為 0.6×22,800/50 ≈ 274 MN。數值為教學假設。~If a rectangular comparison scheme has a base moment M₀ = 30 GN·m, a 24% reduction gives M = 30×0.76 = 22.8 GN·m. If outriggers pass 60% of overturning to the mega-columns with 50 m between tension and compression groups, the axial change per column group falls from 0.6×30,000/50 = 360 MN to 0.6×22,800/50 ≈ 274 MN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 比較多種旋轉角度與漸縮率的風洞力平衡試驗，取各風向的基底彎矩與頂層加速度，確認選定外形的折減在所有風向成立而非只在單一方向；再把最終風載輸入結構模型，檢查外伸臂與巨柱內力是否同步下降。~Compare force-balance wind-tunnel tests for several rotation angles and taper rates, taking base moments and top-floor accelerations for every wind direction to confirm the reduction holds in all directions and not just one; then put the final wind loads into the structural model and check that outrigger and mega-column forces fall accordingly.
units.failure: 若只在一個主風向比較外形，可能漏掉某個斜向風造成的較大扭轉或橫風反應；若後期為了樓層效率修改旋轉角而未重做風洞，原先的 24% 折減就不再有依據，結構可能在設計風載下不足。~Comparing forms in only one principal wind direction can miss larger torsional or across-wind response from an oblique wind; changing the rotation later for floor efficiency without repeating wind-tunnel tests removes the basis for the 24% reduction and can leave the structure short under design wind.
units.misconception: 扭轉外形純粹是造型，結構只是被動配合。~The twisting form is purely aesthetic and the structure merely follows.
units.practice: 把旋轉角、漸縮率與凹槽尺寸列為「受控外形參數」，任何變更都須經風工程與結構顧問重新評估；風洞報告須逐風向列出結果，並說明對照方案的定義。~Treat rotation angle, taper rate and notch size as controlled form parameters that cannot change without reassessment by the wind and structural consultants; the wind-tunnel report must list results by wind direction and define the comparison scheme.

units.anchor: 第四類軟土場址~Site class IV soft ground
units.title: 軟土場址與長週期地震需求~Soft-ground site and long-period seismic demand
units.mechanism: 上海浦東位於深厚的軟弱沖積層上，設計者指出場址屬中國規範的第四類場地，接近美國 IBC 的 F 類軟土。軟土會放大長週期的地震動，而超高層的基本週期常在數秒以上，因此地震雖不如風那樣頻繁，卻可能主導核心連梁、外伸臂與巨柱的部分需求。上海中心採用性能化耐震設計，以多組時間歷程檢核大震下的變位、連梁降伏程度與外伸桁架是否保持彈性。~Pudong in Shanghai sits on deep, soft alluvial deposits; the designers report that the site is class IV in the Chinese code, close to class F soft soil in the IBC. Soft ground amplifies long-period earthquake motion, while supertall fundamental periods are often several seconds or more, so earthquakes, though rarer than strong winds, can govern some demands on core link beams, outriggers and mega-columns. Shanghai Tower used performance-based seismic design, checking drift, link-beam yielding and whether the outrigger trusses stay elastic under several time histories in the major earthquake.
units.model: 場址週期 T_s = 4H/V_s：軟土厚 H = 100 m、平均剪力波速 V_s = 250 m/s 時 T_s = 4×100/250 = 1.6 s。若建築基本週期 T₁ = 9 s、譜加速度 S_a = 0.03 g，譜位移 S_d = S_a·T²/(4π²) = 0.03×9.81×81/39.5 ≈ 0.60 m。週期遠離場址週期，但長週期位移仍很大。數值為教學假設。~Site period T_s = 4H/V_s: with H = 100 m of soft deposits and an average shear-wave velocity V_s = 250 m/s, T_s = 4×100/250 = 1.6 s. If the building period T₁ = 9 s and spectral acceleration S_a = 0.03 g, spectral displacement S_d = S_a·T²/(4π²) = 0.03×9.81×81/39.5 ≈ 0.60 m. The period is far from the site period, yet the long-period displacement remains large. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以場址鑽探與波速量測建立土層模型，做一維場址反應分析取得地表譜；選用含長週期成分的地震紀錄做時間歷程分析，並把長週期段的譜值與規範設計譜比較，確認選用紀錄沒有低估數秒以上的能量。~Build a soil model from site borings and shear-wave velocity measurements and run one-dimensional site-response analysis for the surface spectrum; select records with long-period content for time-history analysis and compare their long-period spectral values with the code spectrum, confirming that the chosen records do not underestimate energy beyond a few seconds.
units.failure: 若只用短週期為主的地震紀錄做分析，長週期位移與連梁轉角會被低估；軟土上的高樓在遠震時也可能出現長時間的晃動，影響電梯運轉與非結構構件。~Analysing only with short-period-dominated records underestimates long-period displacement and link-beam rotation; tall buildings on soft ground can also shake for a long time in distant earthquakes, disrupting elevators and non-structural components.
units.misconception: 建築週期越長，地震力就越小，所以超高層不必擔心地震。~The longer the building period the smaller the earthquake force, so supertall towers need not worry about earthquakes.
units.practice: 性能化設計報告要明列各級地震的性能目標、選用紀錄與其來源、長週期譜的比對，以及同儕審查意見；地震紀錄的選取與調幅須在分析前經審查同意。~The performance-based design report should state the performance targets for each earthquake level, the selected records and their sources, the long-period spectral comparison and the peer-review comments; record selection and scaling must be agreed by the reviewers before analysis.

units.anchor: C70 巨柱與軸壓比~C70 mega-columns and axial-load ratio
units.title: 型鋼混凝土巨柱的軸壓比控制~Axial-load ratio control for steel-reinforced concrete mega-columns
units.mechanism: 上海中心的巨型框架由八支主巨柱與四支角柱（約到第五區為止）組成，巨柱為內含「王」字形鋼骨的型鋼混凝土柱，柱底採 C70 高強度混凝土，含鋼率約 4% 至 5%，並把軸壓比限制在 0.65 以下。軸壓比控制的是柱在地震下的延性：軸壓越高，混凝土越接近壓碎，柱的變形能力越差。鋼骨在工廠預焊，提供施工期的承載與吊裝骨架，也讓柱斷面能隨高度逐段縮小。~Shanghai Tower's mega-frame consists of eight main mega-columns and four corner columns that stop around zone 5. The mega-columns are steel-reinforced concrete built around an internal skeleton of interconnected steel plates and sections, use C70 high-strength concrete at the base with a steel ratio of about 4% to 5%, and keep the axial-load ratio below 0.65. The axial-load ratio governs seismic ductility: the higher the compression, the closer the concrete is to crushing and the less deformation the column can sustain. The steel skeleton is pre-welded in the factory, carries load and serves as the erection frame during construction, and lets the section shrink stage by stage up the tower.
units.model: 軸壓比 μ = N/(f_c·A_c + f_a·A_a)。設斷面 5.0 m × 3.6 m = 18.0 m²、含鋼率 4.5%：A_a = 0.81 m²、A_c = 17.19 m²；C70 設計強度 f_c = 31.8 MPa、鋼 f_a = 295 MPa，分母 = 31.8×17.19 + 295×0.81 ≈ 786 MN；N = 480 MN 時 μ ≈ 0.61 ≤ 0.65。含鋼率降為 4% 時 μ 升為約 0.63。斷面與軸力為教學假設。~Axial-load ratio μ = N/(f_c·A_c + f_a·A_a). For a 5.0 m × 3.6 m = 18.0 m² section with 4.5% steel, A_a = 0.81 m² and A_c = 17.19 m²; with C70 design strength f_c = 31.8 MPa and steel f_a = 295 MPa, the denominator is 31.8×17.19 + 295×0.81 ≈ 786 MN, so N = 480 MN gives μ ≈ 0.61 ≤ 0.65. At 4% steel μ rises to about 0.63. Section and load are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 逐區列出巨柱斷面、含鋼率、混凝土強度與重力加地震組合下的軸壓比，確認每一區都低於限值；鋼骨的工廠焊接以超音波檢測，現場則檢查鋼骨與鋼筋的間距是否足以讓混凝土填實，必要時以足尺模型柱試澆並切開檢查。~Tabulate mega-column section, steel ratio, concrete strength and axial-load ratio under gravity plus earthquake zone by zone, confirming every zone is below the limit; ultrasonically test the factory welds of the steel skeleton, and on site check that spacing between steel and rebar allows full concrete compaction, using a sliced full-scale mock-up where needed.
units.failure: 軸壓比過高的巨柱在大震下延性不足，可能出現混凝土壓碎與鋼筋挫屈；鋼骨與鋼筋排列過密時，混凝土在翼板下方形成空洞，實際容量低於計算值且難以從外觀發現。~Mega-columns with too high an axial-load ratio lack ductility in a major earthquake and can suffer concrete crushing and bar buckling; congested steel and rebar leave voids beneath flanges, so the real capacity falls below the calculation without visible signs.
units.misconception: 只要巨柱強度足夠，軸壓比高一點也沒關係。~As long as a mega-column is strong enough, a somewhat high axial-load ratio does not matter.
units.practice: 巨柱施工前提出鋼骨、鋼筋與澆置孔的三維綜合圖，確認振動棒或自充填混凝土能到達每個角落；澆置後以超音波或敲擊抽查，結果與軸壓比表一起納入竣工資料。~Before mega-column work, submit three-dimensional coordination drawings of steel, rebar and placement openings to confirm that vibrators or self-consolidating concrete can reach every corner; after placement spot-check by ultrasonic testing or tapping and include the results with the axial-load ratio table in the as-built records.

units.anchor: 雙層高外伸桁架~Two-storey outrigger trusses
units.title: 外伸桁架、帶狀桁架與核心牆的力流~Force flow through outriggers, belt trusses and core walls
units.mechanism: 上海中心沿高度分為九個區，每區 12 至 15 層，區與區之間是兩層高的機電與避難層，內設兩層高的鋼外伸桁架與雙道帶狀桁架；公開資料記載外伸桁架共六道。外伸桁架把核心筒的轉角轉成巨柱軸力，帶狀桁架則把角柱與周邊柱連成整圈，並承接懸掛帷幕的荷重。外伸桁架的弦桿要深入約 30 m 見方的核心筒，核心牆在加強層內以鋼板或型鋼補強，才能承受弦桿傳入的巨大水平力。~Shanghai Tower is divided vertically into nine zones of 12 to 15 floors, separated by two-storey mechanical and refuge levels that house two-storey steel outrigger trusses and double belt trusses; public sources record six outrigger levels. The outriggers turn core rotation into mega-column axial force, while the belt trusses tie corner and perimeter columns into a continuous ring and pick up loads from the hung façade. Outrigger chords must penetrate the roughly 30 m square core, whose walls are stiffened with steel plates or sections in the strengthened storeys to take the large horizontal forces delivered by the chords.
units.model: 外伸桁架斜桿力 F = ΔN/sinθ。桁架深 9 m（兩層）、核心到巨柱水平距離 15 m，θ = atan(9/15) ≈ 31.0°、sinθ ≈ 0.514；巨柱軸力變化 ΔN = 60 MN 時 F ≈ 60/0.514 ≈ 117 MN，對應的弦桿水平力 H = ΔN/tanθ = 60/0.6 = 100 MN 要由核心牆吸收。數值為教學假設。~Outrigger diagonal force F = ΔN/sinθ. For a truss 9 m deep (two storeys) spanning 15 m from core to mega-column, θ = atan(9/15) ≈ 31.0° and sinθ ≈ 0.514; a mega-column axial change ΔN = 60 MN gives F ≈ 60/0.514 ≈ 117 MN, and the corresponding chord force H = ΔN/tanθ = 60/0.6 = 100 MN must be absorbed by the core walls. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以局部有限元素模型檢查弦桿與核心牆接合區的應力與鋼板剪力釘配置，確認力流能在牆內擴散；設計者公開說明在大震分析中外伸與帶狀桁架大多保持彈性，驗證時須同時輸出各道桁架的應力比，確認沒有單一道桁架先行降伏。~Check stresses and stud layouts where chords meet the core walls with a local finite-element model, confirming that force spreads into the wall; the designers report that most outrigger and belt trusses stay elastic in the major-earthquake analysis, so verification must output stress ratios for every truss level to confirm that no single level yields first.
units.failure: 若弦桿埋入長度不足或核心牆加強不夠，弦桿力會在牆內造成局部壓碎或剪力裂縫，外伸臂的槓桿作用因而失效；帶狀桁架節點若無法容納懸掛帷幕的附加荷重，外層帷幕會出現不均勻下垂。~If chord embedment is too short or the core is insufficiently stiffened, chord forces crush or shear-crack the wall locally and the outrigger lever action is lost; belt-truss nodes that cannot take the extra load of the hung façade let the outer skin sag unevenly.
units.misconception: 外伸桁架只要在鋼構範圍內設計，核心牆不用另外處理。~Outrigger trusses can be designed within the steelwork alone without special treatment of the core walls.
units.practice: 加強層的鋼構、核心牆鋼板與鋼筋要在同一個三維模型中協調，標示弦桿穿牆處的施工順序與澆置分段；加強層混凝土澆置前設停止點，由結構設計者確認埋件位置與焊接檢驗完成。~Coordinate strengthened-storey steel, core-wall plates and rebar in one three-dimensional model, marking the construction sequence and pour breaks where chords pass through the walls; set a hold point before concreting at which the structural designer confirms embed positions and completed weld inspection.

units.anchor: 圓形地下連續壁~Circular diaphragm wall
units.title: 圓形連續壁與 6 m 筏基的一次澆置~The circular diaphragm wall and a single 6 m mat pour
units.mechanism: 上海中心的基坑總面積約 30,000 m²、深約 33 m，其中塔樓區以內徑 121 m 的圓形地下連續壁圍護。圓形壁把側向土水壓轉成環向壓力，像拱一樣自行平衡，可以不設內支撐而大面積開挖，讓筏基與樁頭施工不受支撐干擾。筏基為直徑約 121 m、厚 6 m 的 C50 混凝土，約 60,000 m³ 一次連續澆置，以避免施工縫削弱這塊承受全塔荷重的厚板；巨量混凝土的水化熱與溫度裂縫則要以配比與監測控制。~Shanghai Tower's foundation excavation covers about 30,000 m² to about 33 m deep, with the tower zone enclosed by a circular diaphragm wall of 121 m inner diameter. A circular wall turns lateral earth and water pressure into hoop compression that balances itself like an arch, so a large area can be excavated without internal struts, leaving the mat and pile-head work unobstructed. The mat is C50 concrete about 121 m across and 6 m thick, about 60,000 m³ placed in one continuous pour to avoid joints weakening a slab that carries the whole tower; hydration heat and thermal cracking of this mass of concrete are controlled by mix design and monitoring.
units.model: 圓形壁環向壓力 N = p·R。開挖底附近側壓 p = 400 kPa、半徑 R = 60.5 m 時 N = 400×60.5 = 24,200 kN/m；壁厚 1.2 m 時平均壓應力約 24,200/1.2 ≈ 20.2 MPa，需高強度混凝土且壁體真圓度要好。若一次澆置 60,000 m³ 費時 63 小時，平均供料約 952 m³/h。側壓、壁厚與時間為教學假設。~Hoop force in a circular wall N = p·R. With lateral pressure p = 400 kPa near formation level and radius R = 60.5 m, N = 400×60.5 = 24,200 kN/m; for a 1.2 m wall the mean compressive stress is about 24,200/1.2 ≈ 20.2 MPa, calling for strong concrete and a truly circular wall. Placing 60,000 m³ in 63 hours would need about 952 m³/h on average. Pressure, thickness and duration are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 連續壁每一槽段施工後以超音波量測垂直度與壁厚，確認圓形幾何偏差在容許範圍；開挖時監測壁體變形、地下水位與鄰近建物沉陷。筏基澆置時在中心、表面與邊緣埋設溫度計，追蹤內外溫差，並記錄供料速率與分層時間，確認沒有冷縫。~Ultrasonically check the verticality and thickness of each diaphragm-wall panel to keep the circular geometry within tolerance, and monitor wall deflection, groundwater and neighbouring settlement during excavation. During the mat pour embed thermometers at the centre, surface and edges to track the temperature difference, and log supply rate and layer timing to confirm there are no cold joints.
units.failure: 圓形壁若某一槽段偏斜或接頭漏水，環向壓力無法均勻傳遞，局部可能彎曲破壞並引起湧砂；巨量筏基若供料中斷形成冷縫，或內外溫差過大造成貫穿裂縫，都會降低筏基的剪力與防水性能。~If one panel of the circular wall is out of line or a joint leaks, hoop compression cannot pass evenly and the wall may fail locally in bending and trigger sand boils; a supply interruption that forms a cold joint in the mat, or an excessive temperature difference that causes through-cracks, reduces the mat's shear capacity and watertightness.
units.misconception: 圓形連續壁只是為了配合圓形建築外形。~A circular diaphragm wall is simply chosen to match the round building outline.
units.practice: 一次澆置的筏基要有供料、泵送、人力與天候的備援計畫，並訂出「供料中斷超過初凝時間即啟動施工縫處理」的停止條件；溫控措施與允許溫差須經設計者核可。~A single-pour mat needs contingency plans for supply, pumping, labour and weather, with a stop rule that a supply break longer than initial set triggers the planned construction-joint procedure; temperature controls and allowable differences require the designer's approval.

units.anchor: 整體鋼平台爬模~Integral steel-platform climbing formwork
units.title: 鋼平台爬模與超高泵送~Steel-platform climbing formwork and extreme pumping
units.mechanism: 上海中心的核心筒以整體鋼平台模板系統施工，平台把模板、鋼筋作業面、布料機與材料堆放整合在核心頂部，靠爬升系統支承在已硬化的核心牆上逐層上升。混凝土由地面一次泵送到位，承攬單位公開的單泵送高度包括 C60 約 582 m、C45 約 606 m、C35 約 610 m，並曾把 120 MPa 超高強度混凝土泵送到約 620 m。平台荷重要靠早齡期的核心牆承擔，爬升時機與支承點強度成為施工控制重點。~Shanghai Tower's core was built with an integral steel-platform formwork system that combines forms, rebar working decks, a placing boom and material storage at the top of the core, climbing floor by floor on supports bearing on hardened core walls. Concrete was pumped from ground level in one stage; the contractor reports single-stage pumping heights of about 582 m for C60, about 606 m for C45 and about 610 m for C35, and pumped 120 MPa ultra-high-strength concrete to about 620 m. The platform's load rests on young core walls, so climbing time and support-point strength become key construction controls.
units.model: 平台總重 2,000 t 加施工荷重 300 t，W = 2,300×9.81 ≈ 22.6 MN，由 12 個支承點分擔約 1.88 MN；若支承處混凝土爬升時強度 15 MPa、容許承壓取 0.6 倍，所需承壓面積 A = 1.88/(0.6×15) ≈ 0.21 m²。強度不足時只能延後爬升或加大承壓板。數值為教學假設。~A platform of 2,000 t plus 300 t of construction load gives W = 2,300×9.81 ≈ 22.6 MN, about 1.88 MN at each of 12 supports; if the wall concrete at the supports is 15 MPa when climbing and allowable bearing is 0.6 times that, the required bearing area is A = 1.88/(0.6×15) ≈ 0.21 m². With less strength, climbing must wait or bearing plates must grow. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每次爬升前以同條件養護試體或成熟度計確認支承處混凝土強度，檢查支承構件、液壓系統與防墜裝置；平台在強風時須鎖定，並以施工階段分析檢查平台荷重與風力下核心牆的應力。泵送則記錄每段高度的壓力與出口性質，並抽驗強度。~Before each climb confirm concrete strength at the supports with field-cured specimens or maturity meters, and check support members, hydraulics and fall arresters; lock the platform in high wind and check core-wall stresses under platform load and wind with a construction-stage analysis. For pumping, log pressure and discharge properties at each height band and sample strength.
units.failure: 若在支承處混凝土強度不足時爬升，局部承壓破壞可能使平台傾斜甚至墜落；泵送高強度混凝土時配比黏度或溫度控制不當，會造成堵管，使樓層澆置中斷並形成冷縫。~Climbing with insufficient concrete strength at the supports can cause local bearing failure, tilting or even dropping the platform; poor control of viscosity or temperature when pumping high-strength concrete leads to blockages that interrupt a floor pour and leave cold joints.
units.misconception: 鋼平台是剛硬的鋼構，所以和下方混凝土的強度無關。~A steel platform is rigid steelwork, so it does not depend on the strength of the concrete below.
units.practice: 平台設計須由專業工程師簽證，施工計畫列出爬升的強度門檻、風速停工條件與緊急鎖定程序；每次爬升設停止點，由現場結構工程師簽核後才可啟動液壓系統。~The platform design must be certified by a professional engineer, and the construction plan lists climbing strength thresholds, wind stop limits and emergency locking procedures; set a hold point for every climb so the hydraulics start only after the site structural engineer signs off.

units.anchor: 後注漿長鑽掘樁~Post-grouted long bored piles
units.title: 軟土中的長樁與樁端後注漿驗證~Long piles in soft ground and verification of base post-grouting
units.mechanism: 上海軟土缺乏淺層堅硬持力層，塔樓以大量長鑽掘樁支承，設計者文章記載為 947 支直徑 1 m、長 52 至 56 m 的鑽掘樁（各資料的支數略有出入），承攬單位指出採用超長鑽掘樁並在樁端後注漿，單樁設計承載可達約 1,000 公噸。樁端後注漿是在混凝土硬化後，經預埋管把水泥漿壓入樁底，填實沉渣並預壓樁底土層，提高端承與底部側摩擦，同時減少沉陷的離散。~Shanghai's soft ground has no shallow hard bearing stratum, so the tower stands on many long bored piles; the designers' article records 947 piles of 1 m diameter and 52 to 56 m length (counts vary slightly between sources), and the contractor reports super-long bored piles with base post-grouting and design capacities up to about 1,000 t each. Base post-grouting injects cement grout through pre-installed pipes after the concrete hardens, filling base debris and pre-loading the soil beneath the toe, which raises end bearing and lower-shaft friction and narrows the scatter of settlement.
units.model: Q = π·D·L·f_s + A_b·q_b。D = 1.0 m、L = 54 m、f_s = 85 kPa：側摩擦 ≈ 14.4 MN；A_b = 0.785 m²，未注漿 q_b = 3 MPa 時端承 2.4 MN、合計 16.8 MN；注漿後 q_b = 6 MPa 時端承 4.7 MN、合計 19.1 MN，安全係數 2 時設計約 9.6 MN（約 975 t）。數值為教學假設。~Q = π·D·L·f_s + A_b·q_b. With D = 1.0 m, L = 54 m and f_s = 85 kPa, shaft friction ≈ 14.4 MN; with A_b = 0.785 m², an ungrouted q_b = 3 MPa adds 2.4 MN for 16.8 MN total, while grouting to q_b = 6 MPa adds 4.7 MN for 19.1 MN, about 9.6 MN (about 975 t) design load at a factor of safety of 2. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每支樁記錄注漿壓力、注漿量與樁頂上抬量，三者須同時達標才算完成；以靜載試驗比較注漿與未注漿試驗樁的荷重—沉陷曲線，並以低應變或聲波透測檢查樁身完整性，結果回饋給群樁沉陷分析。~Record grout pressure, grout volume and pile-head uplift for every pile, accepting only when all three meet the criteria; compare load–settlement curves of grouted and ungrouted trial piles in static load tests, check pile integrity by low-strain or sonic logging, and feed the results back into group-settlement analysis.
units.failure: 注漿管堵塞或注漿量不足的樁，端承仍受沉渣影響，在群樁中成為偏軟的樁，造成筏基不均勻沉陷；注漿壓力過大則可能使漿液沿樁側上竄或擾動鄰近已完成的樁。~Piles with blocked grout pipes or too little grout still sit on base debris and become soft piles in the group, causing uneven mat settlement; excessive grout pressure can drive grout up the shaft or disturb neighbouring finished piles.
units.misconception: 樁端注漿只是補救施工缺陷，正常的樁不需要。~Base grouting is only a fix for construction defects and sound piles do not need it.
units.practice: 注漿規範要訂出最小注漿量、終止壓力與上抬量上限，任何一項異常即停止並由大地顧問判斷；注漿紀錄以樁號編入資料庫，與沉陷監測一起移交業主。~The grouting specification sets minimum grout volume, termination pressure and maximum uplift, stopping for the geotechnical consultant's judgement whenever one is abnormal; index grouting records by pile number in a database and hand them to the owner with the settlement monitoring.

units.anchor: 七組時間歷程與層間變位~Seven time histories and storey drift
units.title: 性能化耐震設計的變位與連梁檢核~Drift and link-beam checks in performance-based seismic design
units.mechanism: 上海中心的性能化耐震設計以七組地震時間歷程分析，設計者公開的結果是大震下平均最大層間變位角小於 1/130，低於 1/100 的限值；多數核心連梁降伏但仍在「生命安全」性能範圍內，外伸與帶狀桁架大多保持彈性。連梁是刻意設計的耗能元件，讓核心牆的牆肢在大震後仍可修復；外伸桁架則必須保持彈性，因為它一旦降伏，整個巨型框架的勁度分配就會改變。~Shanghai Tower's performance-based seismic design used seven sets of time-history analyses; the designers report an average maximum storey drift angle below 1/130 in the major earthquake, within the 1/100 limit, with most core link beams yielding while staying within the life-safety level and most outrigger and belt trusses remaining elastic. Link beams are intended energy-dissipating elements that keep core wall piers repairable after a major earthquake, whereas the outriggers must stay elastic because once they yield, stiffness distribution across the mega-frame changes.
units.model: 層間變位 Δ = θ·h。樓高 4.5 m 時，θ = 1/130 對應 Δ ≈ 34.6 mm，限值 1/100 對應 45 mm。連梁轉角近似 γ = θ·L/l：牆肢形心距 L = 6 m、連梁淨跨 l = 2 m 時 γ ≈ (1/130)×6/2 ≈ 0.023 rad，須小於該連梁配筋形式在生命安全等級的轉角限值。數值為教學假設。~Storey drift Δ = θ·h. For a 4.5 m storey, θ = 1/130 gives Δ ≈ 34.6 mm against 45 mm at the 1/100 limit. Link-beam rotation is roughly γ = θ·L/l: with wall-pier centroids L = 6 m apart and a clear span l = 2 m, γ ≈ (1/130)×6/2 ≈ 0.023 rad, which must stay below the life-safety rotation limit for that reinforcement layout. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依規範取七組以上紀錄時以平均值判定，逐層輸出層間變位角、連梁轉角與外伸桁架應力比，並做敏感度分析（例如混凝土勁度折減、阻尼比變化）；設計結論須經超限高層建築專項審查與同儕審查確認。~With seven or more records, judge on the mean as the code allows; output storey drift angles, link-beam rotations and outrigger stress ratios floor by floor, run sensitivity studies such as cracked-stiffness reductions and damping changes, and have the conclusions confirmed by the special review for code-exceeding tall buildings and by peer review.
units.failure: 若連梁被設計得過強而不先降伏，地震能量會轉移到牆肢底部或外伸桁架，造成難以修復的損傷；若外伸桁架在大震中降伏，巨柱與核心的分擔改變，變位會突然增加。~If link beams are made too strong to yield first, seismic energy shifts to the base of wall piers or to the outriggers, causing damage that is hard to repair; if outriggers yield in a major earthquake, the core–column share changes and drift suddenly increases.
units.misconception: 大震後結構完全不能有任何降伏才算設計成功。~A design succeeds only if nothing yields at all in a major earthquake.
units.practice: 在結構圖上標示「預期降伏構件」與「須保持彈性構件」，前者訂出可更換或修復的細部，後者訂出超強係數；大震後的檢查清單依此分類，優先檢查連梁與外伸桁架接合。~Mark on the structural drawings which members are expected to yield and which must stay elastic, giving the former repairable or replaceable details and the latter overstrength factors; organise the post-earthquake checklist the same way, inspecting link beams and outrigger connections first.

units.anchor: 柔性懸掛帷幕支撐~Flexible hung façade supports
units.title: 懸掛式外層帷幕的變位吸收與維護~Movement absorption and upkeep of the hung outer façade
units.mechanism: 上海中心的外層帷幕與內層樓板之間有中庭空間，外層玻璃不能直接固定在樓板邊緣，而是以柔性懸掛系統掛在每區的機電層帶狀桁架下，允許相對主結構在垂直方向自由變形；承攬單位指出曲面帷幕有超過 20,000 片尺寸各異的玻璃，以柔性懸掛結構與向下施工的智慧平台安裝。懸掛系統要同時吸收溫度伸縮、樓層下垂、風壓與層間變位，接縫與滑動件是長期維護的重點。~Shanghai Tower's outer façade is separated from the floor plates by atrium space, so the outer glass cannot be fixed at slab edges; instead it hangs from the belt trusses at each zone's mechanical level on a flexible suspension system that lets it move vertically relative to the main structure. The contractor reports more than 20,000 glass pieces of different sizes on the curved wall, installed with the flexible suspension and a top-down intelligent platform. The suspension must absorb thermal movement, floor sag, wind pressure and storey drift together, so joints and sliding parts are the focus of long-term upkeep.
units.model: 懸掛段的溫度伸縮 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。一區 14 層、每層 4.5 m，懸掛長度 L ≈ 63 m；α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、ΔT = 40 °C 時 ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×63,000×40 ≈ 30 mm。底部滑動接頭須容許約 ±30 mm 以上，並另加樓層下垂與施工誤差。數值為教學假設。~Thermal movement of a hung segment ΔL = α·L·ΔT. A 14-floor zone at 4.5 m per floor hangs about L ≈ 63 m; with α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C and ΔT = 40 °C, ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×63,000×40 ≈ 30 mm. The bottom sliding joint must allow about ±30 mm or more, plus floor sag and construction tolerances. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以實尺寸試體做垂直往復位移與層間變位試驗，確認滑動接頭不卡死、玻璃不受擠壓；完工後在代表性懸吊桿與滑動件旁設置位移計，比對季節溫差下的實際伸縮，並定期檢查吊桿腐蝕、螺栓鬆脫與密封膠劣化。~Test full-scale specimens under cyclic vertical movement and storey drift to confirm sliding joints do not bind and glass is not squeezed; after completion fit displacement gauges at representative hangers and sliding parts to compare actual seasonal movement, and inspect periodically for hanger corrosion, bolt loosening and sealant ageing.
units.failure: 滑動接頭若被灰塵、腐蝕或施工時誤加的固定件卡死，溫度伸縮會轉成玻璃與框架的附加應力，導致玻璃破裂；懸吊桿螺栓鬆脫則可能使整片帷幕下沉，碰撞下方構件。~If sliding joints are jammed by dirt, corrosion or fixings mistakenly added during construction, thermal movement becomes extra stress in glass and frames and cracks the glass; loosened hanger bolts can let a whole façade panel drop and strike members below.
units.misconception: 帷幕牆掛在結構上，只需要考慮自重，不需要處理變形。~A hung curtain wall only needs to carry its own weight and need not deal with movement.
units.practice: 交接文件要附懸掛系統的滑動方向圖、容許位移、吊桿與螺栓的檢查週期，以及禁止在滑動件上加裝任何附掛物的規定；破損玻璃更換須依原設計間隙重新調整並記錄。~Handover documents should include sliding-direction diagrams, allowable movements, inspection intervals for hangers and bolts, and a rule forbidding any attachment to sliding parts; replacement panes must be re-gapped to the original design clearances and recorded.

units.anchor: 超高速電梯曳引鋼索~Ultra-fast elevator hoist ropes
units.title: 電梯鋼索共振與強風營運模式~Elevator rope resonance and high-wind operating modes
units.mechanism: 上海中心有 106 部電梯，最高速度 20.5 m/s，超長行程的曳引鋼索與補償鋼索像一條很長的弦，自然頻率隨車廂位置改變。當建築在強風下以數秒以上的週期擺動，若鋼索某一長度的頻率接近建築頻率，鋼索就會在井道內共振擺動，碰撞井道設備或纏繞。這個問題屬於結構與機電的介面：結構提供建築頻率與擺幅，電梯系統依此設定強風時的停靠樓層、降速或暫停營運模式。~Shanghai Tower has 106 elevators with a top speed of 20.5 m/s. Very long hoist and compensation ropes behave like long strings whose natural frequency changes with car position. When the building sways with a period of several seconds in strong wind and some rope length has a frequency near the building's, the rope resonates in the shaft, striking equipment or tangling. This is a structure–services interface: the structure supplies building frequency and amplitude, and the elevator system uses them to set high-wind parking floors, reduced speed or suspended service.
units.model: 弦振動頻率 f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ)。張力 T = 100 kN、單位質量 μ = 8 kg/m 時波速 √(100,000/8) ≈ 112 m/s；自由長度 L = 500 m 時 f ≈ 112/1,000 ≈ 0.112 Hz，與週期 9 s 的建築頻率 0.111 Hz 幾乎相同；車廂移到中段使 L = 250 m 時 f ≈ 0.224 Hz，可避開共振。數值為教學假設。~String frequency f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ). With tension T = 100 kN and mass μ = 8 kg/m the wave speed is √(100,000/8) ≈ 112 m/s; for a free length L = 500 m, f ≈ 112/1,000 ≈ 0.112 Hz, almost equal to the 0.111 Hz of a building with a 9 s period; moving the car to mid-height so that L = 250 m gives f ≈ 0.224 Hz, away from resonance. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以結構模型或實測取得建築前幾個模態頻率與預期擺幅，交給電梯廠商做鋼索擺動模擬；完工後在頂部設加速度計與風速計，連動電梯控制系統，於強風事件後檢查井道內鋼索磨損與設備碰撞痕跡。~Provide the elevator supplier with the building's first few modal frequencies and expected amplitudes from the model or measurements for rope-sway simulation; after completion link rooftop accelerometers and anemometers to the elevator controls, and after high-wind events inspect shafts for rope wear and impact marks on equipment.
units.failure: 若電梯設計沒有考慮建築擺動，強風時鋼索可能在井道內大幅擺動，撞壞導軌支架或纏住樓層設備，造成長時間停駛；乘客受困於高空車廂也會成為緊急救援的難題。~If the elevator design ignores building sway, ropes can swing widely in strong wind, damaging rail brackets or snagging landing equipment and causing long outages; passengers trapped in cars at height also become a difficult rescue problem.
units.misconception: 電梯鋼索擺動是機電問題，和結構設計無關。~Elevator rope sway is a mechanical issue unrelated to structural design.
units.practice: 結構設計者應提供電梯顧問書面的模態頻率、預期擺幅與量測資料，雙方共同訂定強風營運模式的啟動門檻；建築重大改裝或阻尼器調整後，須重新確認這些門檻。~The structural designer should give the elevator consultant written modal frequencies, expected amplitudes and measured data, and both should set the trigger thresholds for high-wind operating modes; re-confirm these thresholds after major renovations or damper adjustments.

example: 外形與巨柱連動練習：某超高層矩形對照方案的基底彎矩 M₀ = 30 GN·m，扭轉外形使風載折減 24%，M = 22.8 GN·m。外伸臂把 60% 傾覆彎矩交給巨柱，受拉與受壓側巨柱群力臂 50 m、每側 3 支巨柱：未扭轉時 ΔN = 0.6×30,000/(50×3) = 120 MN，扭轉後 ΔN = 0.6×22,800/(50×3) ≈ 91.2 MN。巨柱斷面 18.0 m²、含鋼率 4.5%，軸壓比分母 31.8×17.19 + 295×0.81 ≈ 786 MN；重力軸力 400 MN 時，未扭轉 μ = 520/786 ≈ 0.66，超過 0.65 限值，扭轉後 μ = 491.2/786 ≈ 0.63，符合要求。也就是說，外形帶來的風載折減可能決定巨柱是否需要加大；若不改外形而改為增加鋼骨，分母須達 520/0.65 = 800 MN，約需多出 (800 − 786)/(295 − 31.8) ≈ 0.055 m² 鋼骨，含鋼率由 4.5% 升到約 4.8%。數值為教學假設，不代表上海中心的設計值。~Form and mega-column exercise: a rectangular comparison scheme has base moment M₀ = 30 GN·m, and a twisting form cuts wind load by 24% to M = 22.8 GN·m. Outriggers pass 60% of overturning to the mega-columns, with 50 m between tension and compression groups and 3 columns per side: without the twist ΔN = 0.6×30,000/(50×3) = 120 MN, with it ΔN = 0.6×22,800/(50×3) ≈ 91.2 MN. For an 18.0 m² mega-column with 4.5% steel, the axial-ratio denominator is 31.8×17.19 + 295×0.81 ≈ 786 MN; with 400 MN of gravity load the untwisted case gives μ = 520/786 ≈ 0.66, above the 0.65 limit, while the twisted case gives μ = 491.2/786 ≈ 0.63, which complies. The form-driven wind reduction can therefore decide whether the mega-columns must grow; keeping the form and adding steel instead requires a denominator of 520/0.65 = 800 MN, or about (800 − 786)/(295 − 31.8) ≈ 0.055 m² of extra steel, raising the steel ratio from 4.5% to about 4.8%. Values are teaching assumptions, not Shanghai Tower's design values.
history: 上海中心大廈由 Gensler 建築設計、Thornton Tomasetti 結構設計，同濟大學建築設計研究院為紀錄建築師與工程師，上海建工集團總承包；2009 年開工、2015 年完工，以 632 m、地上 128 層成為中國最高建築。它在陸家嘴深厚軟土上，以巨型框架、核心筒與外伸臂組成三重抗側體系，並以扭轉外形降低風載、以懸掛雙層帷幕形成垂直分區的中庭。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Shanghai Tower was designed architecturally by Gensler and structurally by Thornton Tomasetti, with Tongji Architectural Design (Group) as architect and engineer of record and Shanghai Construction Group as main contractor; construction began in 2009 and finished in 2015, making it China's tallest building at 632 m with 128 floors above ground. On the deep soft ground of Lujiazui it combines a mega-frame, core and outriggers into a triple lateral system, reduces wind load with a twisting form and uses a hung double-skin façade to create vertically zoned atria. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 建築高度 632 m，地上 128 層、地下 5 層，2015 年完工~Architectural height 632 m with 128 floors above ground and 5 below, completed in 2015
外形扭轉約 120°，結構風載比同高矩形建築約少 24%~The form twists about 120°, cutting structural wind load by about 24% against a rectangular tower
沿高度分為 9 區，每區 12 至 15 層，區間設兩層高機電與避難層~Nine vertical zones of 12 to 15 floors, separated by two-storey mechanical and refuge levels
巨柱底部採 C70 混凝土，含鋼率約 4% 至 5%，軸壓比限值 0.65~Mega-columns use C70 concrete at the base, about 4% to 5% steel, with an axial-load ratio limit of 0.65
核心筒約 30 m 見方，翼牆厚度由約 1.2 m 漸減至 0.5 m~The core is about 30 m square, with wing walls tapering from about 1.2 m to 0.5 m
設計者文章記載 947 支直徑 1 m、長 52 至 56 m 的鑽掘樁~The designers' article records 947 bored piles of 1 m diameter and 52 to 56 m length
筏基厚 6 m、直徑約 121 m，約 60,000 m³ C50 混凝土一次澆置~The mat is 6 m thick and about 121 m across, about 60,000 m³ of C50 concrete in one pour
大震分析平均最大層間變位角小於 1/130，限值 1/100~Major-earthquake analysis gave mean maximum drift below 1/130 against a 1/100 limit
共 106 部電梯，最高速度 20.5 m/s~106 elevators with a top speed of 20.5 m/s
曲面外層帷幕有超過 20,000 片尺寸各異的玻璃~The curved outer façade has more than 20,000 glass pieces of differing sizes
